doc.title: Wayne Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002

chapter: Writing, his own band and listening
title: His own band and the Brass Conference review
summary: Bill Watrous calls about a good review of Andre's band at the Brass Conference after North Texas.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: Well you’re writing, you say you’re doing an awful lot more writing now.
Yeah as a matter of fact Bill Watrous called me just last night, my wife answered the phone and says — my wife answered and he says, “Tell Wayne it’s God.”

So he calls me quite often but he had just picked up this new ITA Journal where I’d gotten a really good review from the Brass Conference. Bill Spilka wrote this article, I mean this is a big — it said that my band, and we followed the One O’Clock North Texas Band. We followed them. And Bill Spilka wrote, it said that this band that Wayne Andre got together, and the music — I haven’t seen the article, Bill was reading it to me — is the best thing that happened at the Brass Conference.
